This talk introduces an innovative collaboration between the University of Texas at San Antonio Research, Smart SA, and multiple San Antonio agencies, integrating San Antonio’s Digital Twin with Large Language Model (LLM)-powered Agentic AI to revolutionize urban planning and management.
The Digital Twin captures real-time city data, including infrastructure, mobility, environmental conditions, and community dynamics, providing a comprehensive digital replica of urban life.

Enhanced with advanced LLM-driven autonomous agents, the system simulates complex urban scenarios, generates actionable insights, and facilitates intuitive, natural-language interactions for planners, policymakers, and residents.

First, we will demonstrate how our research team at secure AI and Autonomy Lab at UTSA successfully replicated the city, covering approximately 1,240 square miles, in UTSA's Secure AI and Autonomy research lab.
Next, we showcase practical applications collaboratively developed, such as Smart Grid Modeling, Heat Island Mitigation, Flood Risk Management, and the optimization of Emergency Services.

By employing autonomous reasoning LLM agents capable of interpreting vast geospatial data streams, this collaboration significantly improves decision-making accuracy, transparency, and citizen engagement.

Attendees will gain insights into how San Antonio leverages this integrated technology partnership to proactively address urban challenges, paving the way toward smarter, more sustainable, and inclusive urban futures.
